scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
If you fought Morocc
and collected
Hero Tokens,
I can exchange them with a special ring for you.
Do you want to take a look at my ring?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
如果您击败了莫拉奇
并收集了英雄代币，
我可以为您将其兑换成特殊的戒指。
您想看看我的戒指吗？

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Your pack has a lot of items,
Please come again after arrange it!
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
您的物品栏里有很多物品，
请先整理好再来吧！

scripts.text: Ring description
scripts.translation: 戒指说明

scripts.text: Exchange with the ring.
scripts.translation: 兑换戒指

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
This Hero Ring
may not
look
impressive,
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
这枚勇士之戒
看起来
也许
并不起眼，

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
but take it to
Expert Enchanter Byrnes,
and he can Enchant
all 4 sockets in it
and bring out
its latent abilities.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
但您可以把它交给
专家附魔师伯恩斯，
他可以附魔
它的全部4个插槽，
从而激发
其潜在的能力。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring
can aid you
in subjugating
Morocc.
Any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
勇士之戒
能帮助您
征服莫拉奇。
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
- Hero Ring -
^006400A ring made for warriors^000000
^006400on the quest to defeat Morocc..^000000
^006400When Enchanted,^000000
^006400it lends its owner^000000
^006400the power to confront Morocc.^000000
^006400Clas: Accessory/DEF: 0^000000
^006400Weight: 20/Required Level: 160^000000
^006400Slot: 0/Equip To: All Jobs^000000

[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring requires
30 Hero Tokens
for the exchange.
Do you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
兑换勇士之戒
需要30个英雄代币。
您想要兑换吗？

scripts.text: Previous menu.
scripts.translation: 返回上一级菜单

scripts.text: Exchange 30 Hero Tokens.
scripts.translation: 兑换30个英雄代币

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Think
again.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
再考虑
一下。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
^006400Hero Token^000000
is given to
those who bravely fought Morocc.
You don't have
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000,
and therefore I can't assist you.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
^006400英雄代币^000000
是颁发给
勇敢对抗莫拉奇的人的。
您没有
30个^006400英雄代币^000000，
所以我无法为您提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
I'll exchange
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000
with 1 ^006400Hero Ring^000000.
Anything else?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
我将用
30个^006400英雄代币^000000
兑换1枚^006400勇士之戒^000000。
还有其他需要吗？

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
One day
you'll find yourself
in need of Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
总有一天，
您会发现
自己需要勇士之戒。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Have you heard of Hero Ring? Only true heroes deserve to possess that magnificent ring, and I've been waiting for one.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
你听说过勇士之戒吗？只有真正的英雄才配拥有那枚华丽的戒指，我一直在等待它。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Enchant Hero Ring.
scripts.translation: 附魔勇士之戒

scripts.text: Reset Enchantments on Hero Ring.
scripts.translation: 重置勇士之戒的附魔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
I can Enchant only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to Enchant?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
我只能附魔已装备的戒指。你想附魔哪一枚已装备的戒指？

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左路

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右路

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip the Hero Ring that you want to enchant.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
请装备你想附魔的勇士之戒。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't Enchant anything else.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
请装备您的勇士之戒。我无法附魔其他物品。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
A fully enchanted Hero Ring cannot be enchanted any further.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
完全附魔的勇士之戒无法再进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot {0}?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您想在第{0}个槽位附魔哪种能力？

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Enchantment completed!
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
附魔完成！

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
To reset Enchantments on your Hero Ring, I need 3 Hero Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
要重置勇士之戒的附魔，我需要3个勇士令牌。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的勇士令牌不足。我无法重置您的勇士之戒。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
I can reset only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to reset?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
我只能重置已装备的戒指。您想重置哪一枚已装备的戒指？

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左路

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右路

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You first have to equip the item to reset its Enchantment status.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您必须先装备该物品，才能重置其附魔状态。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't reset anything else.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
请装备您的勇士之戒。我无法重置其他物品。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的勇士令牌不足。我无法重置您的勇士之戒。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Your Hero Ring is currently in a state without enchantment.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的勇士之戒目前处于未附魔状态。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Initialization completed.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
初始化完成。
